name: Submerged bridge
note: Synthetic demonstration scenario. Not a reconstruction of any real flood event and not validated against observations. The deck height is read from a DSM surface at the bridge midpoint, so it approximates the canopy/road surface, not a surveyed deck.
expectedEffects: the bridge edge disappears from every route
settlements on the far side gain at least one hop
closest reachable shelter changes for affected places

name: Blocked approach road
note: Synthetic demonstration scenario. Not a reconstruction of any real flood event and not validated against observations. No live road-closure feed is used; the closure is authored.
expectedEffects: travel time increase for the affected shelter catchment
possible loss of access within the stated time budget

name: Rising water level
note: Synthetic demonstration scenario. Not a reconstruction of any real flood event and not validated against observations. The level series is arbitrary, not an observed hydrograph. Show that sentence on screen.
expectedEffects: monotonic growth of flooded road km, flooded camps and flooded buildings
loss of the lowest crossings first

name: Settlement cut off
note: Synthetic demonstration scenario. Not a reconstruction of any real flood event and not validated against observations. The isolation is engineered for demonstration; it is not an observed cut-off event.
expectedEffects: an explicit no-viable-evacuation state instead of a bogus route

name: Fastest route is unsafe
note: Synthetic demonstration scenario. Not a reconstruction of any real flood event and not validated against observations. Risk weights are authored and not empirically calibrated.
expectedEffects: the fastest route is flagged unsafe
the safe route is longer but avoids deep water and unassessed bridges
